verdict.rationale: Baseten is a model-serving/inference and training platform, not an agentic client that would itself consume external MCP servers; the evidence shows Baseten *publishing* an MCP server for other coding agents to use its workspace (docs-5), and supports model-level function/tool calling, but nothing indicates Baseten itself plugs in MCP servers to gain their tools. This axis is a category mismatch for an inference/deployment platform rather than an agent.
